propositions: Add LLMRuntime auth capability type to accept provider-native pre-client auth/session capabilities (boto3 Session, Anthropic token provider, OpenAI workload identity) without serialization or persistence in config/cache/output
Extend PydanticAIRunner/get_runner to receive optional LLMRuntime and pass it into the single per-run ProviderSession builder for Anthropic/Bedrock/OpenAI without altering retry/cache/policy logic
Ensure Rebar retains exclusive client ownership and lifecycle control; fail before provider request if explicit auth is absent or conflicting, with no ambient principal fallback
Auth injection must not affect _pai_structured operation, output repair, request budget, cache accounting, exhaustion behavior, tracing, usage normalization, or failure translation from RP-01
Secret credentials must remain non-serializable and unwrap only inside the selected provider builder, absent from config/request/snapshot/fingerprint/cache/schema/output/logs/exceptions
Runtime input is optional; absence delegates to unchanged RP-01 construction; rollback removes the new argument before callers require it
